== Strategy ==

well the strategy is simple. beat the jedi. until recently i was able to get rid of quigon and obiwan, now that i have sidious i can get rid of all the jedi.
first off pull fanfare,then pull quigons end hold that until you have lord vader and maul with their sticks at a site.use the circle on obi wan then duel qui gon away, play quigona end. now you have two jedi gone. most decks only run quigon,obiwan and luke jedi knight, which means you only have to deal with luke jedi knight. and with sidious in the deck you can get rid of luke easily also. you have plenty of destiny sevens so you wont have a problem getting a destiny seven under a dark jedi and drawing another destiny seven.you have good backup so if they arent playing on naboo you will be able to hold all of your sites. if set up right you can drain for up to 10 force or more a turn.

also the finger of death rules!!!!!!
